name: Hetaro Pearlbaton
original_name: ヘータロー・パールバトン
source:
A member of [url=/c52315]Anastasia[/url] Camp, and the middle triplet brother. He is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary group Fang of Iron. Unlike his cheerful sister, Hetaro has a more cautious personality, which comes from his experiences of taking care of his sister. As he is a siscon, he generally tends to let his sister do whatever she wants, leading her to grow into her current personality, though because of this he is attentive and is sensitive to changes in mood. Despite this, he is also on good terms with his younger brother Tivey, who listens to what he has to say. Due to Ricardo's habit of heading straight into the battle, he is virtually the commander of the Fang of Iron while in battle.

[From [url=https://rezero.fandom.com/wiki/Hetaro_Pearlbaton]Re:Zero Wiki[/url]]
